decision: LLM detection order updated to prioritise zero-config CLI tools (Claude Code CLI, Copilot CLI) over API keys, with Ollama moved to last resort.
key_insight: LLM detection order updated to prioritise zero-config CLI tools (Claude Code CLI, Copilot CLI) over API keys, with Ollama moved to last resort.
alternatives_considered: Separate config file to specify provider preference
rejected_reason: Most users running Quorum via an agent already have Claude Code or Copilot authenticated — requiring them to set an API key is unnecessary friction
Config file adds maintenance surface with no benefit when detection works correctly
